Unblocks workflow-heal issue #8064 and fixes two heal-pipeline gaps found while investigating its `heal_scope_plan_out_of_scope` hold (plan run 40085808345).

Refs #8064, #7913.

### 1. Validation sandbox tests the branch's own support files (the #8064 fix)

Self-repo support staging copies trusted versions of four support files over the validation checkout (#6865). The sandbox's screened copy read the working tree, so the branch's own tests ran against `main`'s copies. That made #7913 fail validation with `harness_error` (run 40083109127).

- `scripts/validation_harness_sandbox.sh`: `cmd_run` passes `HEAD:<path>` for `validate_process.sh`, `validation_harness_sandbox.sh`, `codex_isolated_workspace.py` and `templates/slot_manifest.schema.json`. `STAGE_PY`'s new `stage_from_head` stages their `HEAD` blobs. It only takes regular blobs, reads them with a raw `cat-file` under the hardened git env, and logs `reason=support_from_head`. In any other case it falls back to today's working-tree read.
- The host still runs only trusted copies. `validate_driver.sh` stays the trusted overlay because the sandbox runs it.

### 2. Heal issues can ship their own `agents.d/` fragment

The heal scope marker only carries `tests/**` and `changelog.d/*.md`, so the agents fragment CLAUDE.md §30 requires was held at plan time and refused at implement time, even after `/approved`. The issue's own `agents.d/<N>-*.md` is now accepted by:

- the heal plan gate (`files_touched_scope_guard.py`, `heal_own_agents_fragment_entry`);

It only takes regular blobs, reads them with a raw `cat-file` under the hardened git env, and logs `reason=support_from_head`. In any other case it falls back to today's working-tree read.
- The host still runs only trusted copies. `validate_driver.sh` stays the trusted overlay because the sandbox runs it.

2026-10-24T14:21:38.1083683Z   pr_body: ## Summary

Consumer repos can no longer change the managed workflow wrappers (the files shipped from `workflow-templates/*.yml`). The approved design adds three layers, plus Q4 (tele-funtoken's owner-marker rule moves upstream).

### 1. Integrity check (new)
- `workflow-templates/ai-workflow-integrity.yml`, added to the `core`, `standard` and `full` profiles, calls the new reusable `.github/workflows/workflow_integrity.yml` on `pull_request_target` and on every branch `push`.
- It reads the base and head trees as git objects; nothing from the consumer runs. When a managed wrapper changed, it:
  - takes the single release SHA pinned in the head's `ai-workflow-integrity.yml`;
  - fetches that commit in the updater's sparse shape;
  - verifies the signed `sync-manifest.json` (tag, Sigstore identity, commit and file hashes). The verifier is a byte copy of `update_workflows.yml`'s, and a test pins the two together;
  - renders the templates with that release's own renderer;
  - requires every managed wrapper to be byte-identical: the profile manifest, the integrity wrapper, and the updater when present.
- Pull requests get the commit status `coding-workflows/workflow-integrity`. Push runs only fail the job, so they never overwrite a PR verdict.
- Because the check runs on `pull_request_target`, it runs from the base branch. A PR cannot edit the check that judges it.

### 2. Opt-out removed for wrappers

2026-10-24T13:44:25.2852316Z   pr_body: ## Summary

Consumer repos can no longer change the managed workflow wrappers (the files shipped from `workflow-templates/*.yml`). The approved design adds three layers, plus Q4 (tele-funtoken's owner-marker rule moves upstream).

### 1. Integrity check (new)
- `workflow-templates/ai-workflow-integrity.yml`, added to the `core`, `standard` and `full` profiles, calls the new reusable `.github/workflows/workflow_integrity.yml` on `pull_request_target` and on every branch `push`.
- It reads the base and head trees as git objects; nothing from the consumer runs. When a managed wrapper changed, it:
  - takes the single release SHA pinned in the head's `ai-workflow-integrity.yml`;
  - fetches that commit in the updater's sparse shape;
  - verifies the signed `sync-manifest.json` (tag, Sigstore identity, commit and file hashes). The verifier is a byte copy of `update_workflows.yml`'s, and a test pins the two together;
  - renders the templates with that release's own renderer;
  - requires every managed wrapper to be byte-identical: the profile manifest, the integrity wrapper, and the updater when present.
- Pull requests get the commit status `coding-workflows/workflow-integrity`. Push runs only fail the job, so they never overwrite a PR verdict.
- Because the check runs on `pull_request_target`, it runs from the base branch. A PR cannot edit the check that judges it.

### 2. Opt-out removed for wrappers
- `update_workflows.yml` no longer skips the job when `allow_workflow_edits` is false. It logs `WORKFLOW_EDITS_OPT_OUT outcome=ignored scope=managed_wrappers` plus a deprecation warning, updates

2026-10-24T12:56:24.8915134Z   pr_body: ## Summary

Unblocks workflow-heal issue #8064 and fixes two heal-pipeline gaps found while investigating its `heal_scope_plan_out_of_scope` hold (plan run 40085808345).

Refs #8064, #7913.

### 1. Validation sandbox tests the branch's own support files (the #8064 fix)

Self-repo support staging copies trusted versions of four support files over the validation checkout (#6865). The sandbox's screened copy read the working tree, so the branch's own tests ran against `main`'s copies. That made #7913 fail validation with `harness_error` (run 40083109127).

- `scripts/validation_harness_sandbox.sh`: `cmd_run` passes `HEAD:<path>` for `validate_process.sh`, `validation_harness_sandbox.sh`, `codex_isolated_workspace.py` and `templates/slot_manifest.schema.json`. `STAGE_PY`'s new `stage_from_head` stages their `HEAD` blobs. It only takes regular blobs, reads them with a raw `cat-file` under the hardened git env, and logs `reason=support_from_head`. In any other case it falls back to today's working-tree read.
- The host still runs only trusted copies. `validate_driver.sh` stays the trusted overlay because the sandbox runs it.

### 2. Heal issues can ship their own `agents.d/` fragment

2026-10-24T12:55:52.3389967Z   pr_body: ## Summary

Consumer repos can no longer change the managed workflow wrappers (the files shipped from `workflow-templates/*.yml`). The approved design adds three layers, plus Q4 (tele-funtoken's owner-marker rule moves upstream).

### 1. Integrity check (new)
- `workflow-templates/ai-workflow-integrity.yml`, added to the `core`, `standard` and `full` profiles, calls the new reusable `.github/workflows/workflow_integrity.yml` on `pull_request_target` and on every branch `push`.
- It reads the base and head trees as git objects; nothing from the consumer runs. When a managed wrapper changed, it:
  - takes the single release SHA pinned in the head's `ai-workflow-integrity.yml`;
  - fetches that commit in the updater's sparse shape;
  - verifies the signed `sync-manifest.json` (tag, Sigstore identity, commit and file hashes). The verifier is a byte copy of `update_workflows.yml`'s, and a test pins the two together;
  - renders the templates with that release's own renderer;
  - requires every managed wrapper to be byte-identical: the profile manifest, the integrity wrapper, and the updater when present.
- Pull requests get the commit status `coding-workflows/workflow-integrity`. Push runs only fail the job, so they never overwrite a PR verdict.
- Because the check runs on `pull_request_target`, it runs from the base branch. A PR cannot edit the check that judges it.

### 2. Opt-out removed for wrappers
- `update_workflows.yml` no longer skips the job when `allow_workflow_edits` is false. It logs `WORKFLOW_EDITS_OPT_OUT outcome=ignored scope=managed_wrappers` plus a deprecation warning, update
